text:
alex: Heads-up — thinking about quota enforcement changes for the console. Proposal: add a "quota_profile" selector per route so chat / embeddings / rerank / streaming can pick different backing buckets. Thoughts?

maria: ++ this makes sense for tuning bursts per workload. main concern is telemetry and billing complexity.

jon: Question — are we moving to per-org buckets, per-key buckets, or a hybrid? we need to avoid exploding token-buckets in storage.

rosa: i'd favour a 2-layer model: org-level steady-state bucket + per-key short-lived burst buckets. that keeps predictable cost while allowing spikes.

alex: rough console config idea: we let a route reference a profile id. example:```json
{
  "route": "POST /v1/chat",
  "quota_profile": "chat-high-burst",
  "enforce": true
}
```
profile fields: token_rate, burst_capacity, request_rate, burst_weight.

sam: streaming is special — we need concurrent-stream caps + token-rate. streaming spikes are about open connections, not just tokens. we should separate those controls.

sre-bot: deploybot: rate-limiter v1 rolled to staging -> /rate-limit now supports "burst_weight" parameter (see changelog).

maria: Telemetry checklist: per-route tokens_consumed, bursts_used, throttles, request_count. also tag by rollout id so evals can compare.

jon: edge-case: rerank endpoints often have huge qps but tiny tokens per request. we need a request-count quota dimension for rerank to prevent queue saturation.

rosa: agreed. define two quota dimensions: token_rate and request_rate. ui should let customers compose rules like: "if route == rerank then request_rate = 2000/s else token_rate = 10k/s".

alex: UX ask: during rollouts show expected latency/cost impact if you switch a route to a stricter profile. perhaps a simulator that replays recent traffic against candidate profile and shows p50/p95 latency + projected token spend.

sam: enforcement note: implement leaky-token-buckets in the edge proxy with sticky-hashing for buckets to avoid central coordinator hotspots. fall back to central store if shard misses occur.

maria: ops requirement: add an emergency global throttle in console (single-click kill switch) with audit log. must integrate with incident runbooks.

jon: next steps / owners: jon -> PR for rate-limiter API + proxy changes; rosa -> console wireframe + mock for quota_profile selector; maria -> telemetry schema + dashboard panels; sam -> design docs for streaming limits; alex -> rollout simulator spec. @sre-bot please post staging deploy results.

alex: thanks all :thumbsup: sync tomorrow 10am to review mocks and API draft.
